events.event_name: Walk the Runway at Century 21 NYC
events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt Street, New York, NY 10007
events.what_it_is: A free public in-store runway where visitors can walk the runway and be filmed for Century 21 social stories.
events.what_is_free: Each runway participant receives a Century 21 tote and up to five iron-on patches while supplies last; participants also receive a $21-off-$100 in-store offer card.
events.caveats: Century 21's official page says there is no ticket, invitation, registration or online sign-up. Participants are filmed for the store's Instagram/TikTok stories. Totes and patches are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday September 15 and Wednesday September 16, 12 PM–6 PM each day. Main floor, Dey Street side. Walk-in; get in line during event hours.

events.address: Sephora SoHo, 557 Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A two-day Medik8 skincare pop-up at Sephora SoHo with personalized skincare consultations, samples and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary personalized skincare consultations, samples and giveaways; gifts with purchase are also advertised.
events.caveats: Medik8's official IRL page lists RSVP for both NYC dates. The September 16 Ariana Madix meet-and-greet is a separate purchase-qualified component: the first 150 eligible customers purchasing two or more full-size Medik8 products receive wristbands; a Partiful ticket does not guarantee meet-and-greet entry.
events.practical_notes: September 16: main pop-up 12 PM–5:30 PM, with purchase-qualified Ariana Madix meet-and-greet 6–8 PM. September 17: pop-up 11 AM–7 PM. Do not represent the celebrity meet-and-greet as part of ordinary free admission.

events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with cat-themed installations, games and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat-treat samples plus chances to win Cat Bodega merchandise through games such as a claw machine and scratch-offs.
events.caveats: Mars/TEMPTATIONS describes the physical pop-up as free and gives daily hours. Treat samples and merchandise as promotional inventory; prizes are chance-based and supplies can run out.
events.practical_notes: September 17–19, 12 PM–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. Public walk-in access; no RSVP or ticket requirement was published in the first-party announcement.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle / Meatpacking Plaza, 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Streets, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day branded NYC newsstand celebrating Bobbi Brown's Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ launch, with sampling, refreshments, scratch-off prizes and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Face Base+ sample, grapefruit Spindrift, mini croissant and scratch-off giveaway while supplies last; the first 100 guests in line are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The current Eventbrite listing is organized by Bobbi Brown Cosmetics and advertises the event as free with giveaways. Samples, refreshments and prizes are while supplies last. Photo/video capture for Bobbi Brown social and digital channels is disclosed.
events.practical_notes: Thursday September 17, 12 PM–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle. Free registration is currently available through the Bobbi Brown-organized Eventbrite listing.

events.event_name: CookUnity The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Five Manhattan bodegas: 451 Third Ave; 266 W 23rd St; 369 Madison Ave; 275 W 4th St; 873 Broadway, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas/delis where eight chefs serve complimentary CookUnity meals and hot samples.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary chef-made meals and hot bites while supplies last, plus a bodega-style scratch-off with chances to win additional CookUnity prizes.
events.caveats: Multiple current NYC sources independently agree that the event is open to the public and free, with meals while supplies last. No RSVP/ticket requirement is published. Arriving early is advisable because inventory is finite.
events.practical_notes: Thursday September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM at Bari Bodega (873 Broadway), Madison Square Deli & Convenience (266 W 23rd St), New York Pizza and Cafe (369 Madison Ave), Sam's Deli (275 W 4th St), and Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill (451 Third Ave).
